# NFSU2 Server control v1.8.3

## Fixed
- Existing WSL checkouts can recover the exact Docker allowlist and shell-file permission changes created by older installers, then fast-forward to the current upstream source.
- Other staged or tracked user changes are not overwritten; a binary Git patch is saved under `C:\\nfsu2\\logs` and setup stops with its location.
- The installer no longer mass-chmods tracked shell scripts or rewrites tracked Docker source files during setup.
- The project file manager validates a Git source checkout before Compose and `.env.local` have been generated, so it remains available after an interrupted build.
- Added a regression test for a valid project checkout with no Compose file and no `.env.local`.
